discoveryNotes.notes:
I found no new local free-food deals for Oct 24–Nov 14, 2026 that I could confirm. I hit the search limit after about a dozen searches, so coverage of New Braunfels, Schertz, Cibolo, Universal City, Boerne, Helotes, Converse and Live Oak is thin. Please run this task again soon.

Checked and skipped:
- Tropical Smoothie Cafe opening at 7411 N. Loop 1604 E today (first 50 get free smoothies for a year; $1.99 smoothies all day): already in the app.
- Already over: Smalls Sliders at 8743 SH-151 W (opened Oct 12; first 100 who bought a combo got a free monthly combo for a year) and Reunion Coffee's free-drink reopening day (Oct 11).
- Smalls Sliders lead: the franchisee (Hakim Corp.) says two more San Antonio locations will open in the next 3–4 months. No dates yet; watch for another "free for a year" opening.
- Free-entry events where food is sold, not given away (not added):
  - Market Square Día de los Muertos, Oct 24–25.
  - Calaveras de Azucar Festival at Market Square, Oct 31 (10am–9:30pm) and Nov 1 (10am–8:30pm).
  - Luminaria on Houston St, Nov 13–15.
- Panda Fest at Hemisfair is Nov 21–22, outside the date window.
- Boerne openings (Firehouse Subs, a Panda Express-type project) have no confirmed dates or giveaways. The Screaming Goat Yard & Tap near the RIM is due to open by the end of November; no promo found (its article wouldn't load).

I ran out of search and fetch calls early, so most of these deals come from one source, Sporked's Oct 18 weekly roundup. All are marked unconfirmed. Leads I didn't submit: Cicis $5.99 buffet for Rewards members on Mon/Tue (I couldn't confirm a San Antonio location). Long John Silver's daily Rewards codes: MONDAY, 10TUES, WED25, 3MTHURS, DTFISH, WKNDFAM. Moe's BOGO entrée on Oct 31. MOOYAH kids eat free on Halloween. KCL also lists Grubhub-style offers: IHOP free short stack with $15+, KFC free 2-pc combo with $15+, Pizza Hut BOGO Personal Pan, Sonic free mozzarella sticks or pretzel twist on a first $20+ order. Those had no dates. 7-Eleven also offers $3 8-pc boneless wings with a whole pizza and 2 roller-grill items for $3.50. National Sandwich Day (Nov 3) deals are still mostly predicted, apart from McAlister's, which the app already has.

My search limit ran out early, so I found no new weekly specials I could confirm. Leads to check later: (1) Denny's kids eat free: a MySA article updated Aug 2026 says kids usually eat free with a $6+ adult entrée, but it gives no day or time, and locations vary. (2) Jason's Deli kids eat free: the brand's page says it's at participating delis only, with a kids meal free with an adult entrée (dine-in or pickup), but days and times vary by deal. I found no San Antonio days. (3) Torchy's Tacos happy hour: the only sources were an old Tripadvisor photo caption ($6 Torchy Tini, Thursday 3-7) and a 2025 roundup that isn't specific to San Antonio. Both are out of date. (4) Fuzzy's Taco Shop happy hour and Taco Tuesday: I only saw a 2025 Denver-area article. Nothing for San Antonio this year. Other ideas I didn't get to: Twin Peaks, Bubba's 33, Golden Corral and Main Event specials at San Antonio locations, Chili's weekly specials, and Taco Bell's recurring Tuesday Drops.

I hit the search/fetch limit early, so I didn't check gift-card bonuses at Chili's, Texas Roadhouse or Olive Garden, Thanksgiving-week deals, or Whataburger and other local brands. Those are worth a follow-up search. National Sandwich Day (Tue 11/3): the only confirmed deal is McAlister's $5 sandwich, already in the app. Jimmy John's, Subway, Potbelly, Popeyes and Schlotzsky's are still predictions (Krazy Coupon Lady). National Nacho Day (11/6): the only lead is Moe's rewards nachos, from one aggregator, so I skipped it. Taco Bell's 'Steal a Base, Steal a Taco' is NOT running for the 2026 World Series (USA Today via Yahoo). Possible Veterans Day leads I skipped because I'm not sure they have San Antonio locations: Carrabba's (BOGO take-home entrée Nov 8-10, free appetizer or dessert Nov 11), Smashburger (free All-American Smash), Capriotti's (free small sub with purchase), Bar Louie (free burger Nov 10-11). Menchie's free 6 oz froyo is only confirmed for 2025. Also from Dinova's 2026 guide: Dave & Buster's lists free unlimited game play and/or free dessert with an entrée (dine-in), which could fill in the 'TBA' D&B entry already in the app. Spurs 2026-27: the only food perk found is the Fri-Sun meal-deal add-on, already in the app.

I hit the search limit early, so I didn't get to cover Capital One Offers or to double-check every lead. Leads I didn't submit: (1) Amex Offer at Moe's Southwest Grill: 15% back on one purchase, up to $6, expires Oct 31, 2026 (from Upgraded Points' Amex Offers list, updated Oct 21). I left it out because I couldn't confirm there's a Moe's in the San Antonio area. (2) Upgraded Points lists a Citi Uber Eats offer as expiring Sept 18, 2026. That conflicts with the Oct 31 end date in the app's existing Uber Eats Citi entry and should be rechecked. (3) Capital One Dining's reservation platform shut down in late September 2026; its exclusive dining experiences moved to Capital One Entertainment. (4) The other Amex dining offers I saw (Grand Lux Cafe, Five Napkin Burger, Boqueria, Wally's, Acadia) are probably not at San Antonio restaurants. Athletic Brewing isn't a restaurant. I also only checked Pei Wei's San Antonio locations from memory, not with a search, so confirm there's a nearby Pei Wei before relying on that deal.

My search budget ran out early, so I never got to Bush's Chicken, Taco Palenque, Pollos Asados Los Norteños, Jim's, Rudy's, San Antonio FC or Raising Cane's own pages. Those are worth another pass. What I checked: (1) Spurs Tipoff Week (Oct 13-20, including the Whataburger app's free onion rings on Oct 16) is over, and the 2026 playoff and Finals win freebies (Taco Palenque SPURSWIN etc.) are over too. I found no regular-season 'if the Spurs win' deal for 2026-27. (2) UTSA football: the goutsa.com/promotions page only lists sweepstakes: a Raising Cane's 'MVPet' pet-photo contest (2 tickets plus a Cane's prize pack, one winner per home game), a $100 McDonald's gift card giveaway and a Gold's Gym contest for the final home game vs. Tulsa. At home games, in-game prizes like Whataburger gift cards and Raising Cane's coupons go to random fans, and sponsor booths in Rowdy Town Live (Whataburger, Raising Cane's) hand out food samples. None of that is a guaranteed deal, so I left it out. (3) Whataburger's holiday menu (from Oct 20), Taco Cabana's Chicken Poblano lineup (Oct 21) and Bill Miller's fall pumpkin pie ($2.75 a slice) are new menu items, not discounts.

I ran out of searches and fetches early, so the list is short. I couldn't confirm: Jason's Deli birthday dessert (its FAQ asks "Do you still offer a birthday reward?", so it may have ended), Pei Wei's actual items (FAQ not opened), Smashburger birthday shake, Potbelly, CAVA, Insomnia Cookies, Benihana and Rita's (not sure they have San Antonio locations). Zaxby's, Moe's and Noodles skipped as probably not in San Antonio. Most of the unconfirmed birthday perks come from just one aggregator (The Freebie Guy, updated about Oct 2026) and should be checked in each brand's app.
